Five days walking in Liechtenstein 🇱🇮 🏔️

From hiking the ridges along Route 66 to walking down into the villages and valleys through the Alpine Ridge Trail, every day was different. High peaks in the morning, castles and museums in the afternoon: the smallest Alpine country has a lot packed into it, and we will be back.

Locations:

📍 Alpweg
📍 Gratshütte
📍 Zwei Brüder
📍 Felsord
📍 Talbun
📍 Rheinstadt

Trip w/ @example_tourism_board
